sources: Flare 2.0 练后 专项补强 + Flare2 2026-11-21（Google 表 1aCseEk4vslsG-QKb-zsZwg30amvoYh5tMxzy6p9n8vA，练后专项补强：跪姿拳面支撑）

purpose.zh: 跪姿用拳头撑地，练手腕在直线上承重的力量，为拳撑和地面支撑打底
purpose.en: A kneeling plank on your fists: trains the wrists to carry weight in a straight line, a base for knuckle and floor supports.

text.zh: 拳面撑地，手腕绝对直，手臂伸直
text.en: Knuckles down, wrists dead straight, arms locked

text.zh: 重心压在食指和中指的指根关节上，拳心相对。
text.en: Weight on the index and middle knuckles, palms facing each other.

text.zh: 拳头在肩膀正下方，前臂竖直。
text.en: Fists right under the shoulders, forearms vertical.

text.zh: 双膝着垫，膝、髋、肩一条线，肚子收住。
text.en: Knees down, knees-hips-shoulders in one line, belly in.

commonErrors.en: Letting the wrists bend in or out.

commonErrors.zh: 重心压在无名指和小指上
commonErrors.en: Weight sliding onto the ring and little fingers.

cautions.zh: 垫子太薄、指根硌疼就叠一层毛巾
cautions.en: If your knuckles hurt on a thin mat, fold a towel under them.

cautions.zh: 手腕刺疼就停下，改用手掌撑
cautions.en: Stop if your wrist hurts sharply; go back to flat palms.

flare2.item: 练后专项补强：跪姿拳面支撑
flare2.camera: 侧前方（看得到前臂竖直、手腕直和身体一条线）；手部特写看拳面着地
flare2.doseBrief: 表：静态 20 秒；草稿 1 组（组数待定）
flare2.note: Animation r3: kneeling plank on fists (V5 finger pose floorFist), palms facing in, hand bone vertical in line with the forearm (sandbox wrist bend ~1 deg), static 8 s loop.

set.zh: 拳头在肩膀正下方，前臂竖直
set.en: Fists under the shoulders, forearms vertical

set.zh: 手腕绝对直，别往里或往外折
set.en: Wrists dead straight, no bending in or out

set.zh: 重心压在食指和中指的指根上
set.en: Weight over the index and middle knuckles
